summary: Retained ObjectGenome generation-8 source has no project-owned canonical recipe size/work envelope. Semantic keys are capped at 512 bytes, but provenance manufacturerFamily/productLine/apparentEra use only non-empty-string validation, and dense components/mechanisms/affordances/supportKeys arrays have no count ceiling. This permits arbitrarily large otherwise-canonical ObjectGenome records and unbounded validation/fingerprint work; component support reachability is additionally worst-case quadratic because it may scan the full component array once per component. No existing PR/issue found for this exact bounded-recipe surface.
evidence: Inspected retained generation-8 PR #395 exact head ebfd17e7a2d5cf2083b90e0122b70bc5c39d0962, which is the currently source/test-approved ObjectGenome candidate.

ObjectGenome.luau caps semantic keys through STABLE_ID_SEMANTIC_PART_MAX_BYTES=512, but provenance.manufacturerFamily, provenance.productLine, and provenance.apparentEra are checked only with isNonEmptyString() and therefore have no byte envelope.
validateDenseArray() proves only dense 1-based shape; inspect() accepts any positive componentCount and likewise imposes no maximum on mechanisms, affordances, or per-component supportKeys.

The support-reachability pass loops from 1..componentCount and rescans value.components each pass. A reverse-ordered support chain can require repeated propagation passes, making validation work O(componentCount^2) before later fingerprint traversal.

recipeFingerprint() chunks individual payload strings into 384-byte StableId inputs, which protects StableId part size but does not bound total canonical recipe bytes or total fingerprint CPU across an arbitrarily large accepted recipe.

Repository PR and issue searches for ObjectGenome provenance/collection capacity/budget found no current or historical owner of this exact surface. PR #395's generation-8 delta addresses decoder exact-shape, semantic-key length, familyVersion, issue ordering, and ObjectState aliasing—not canonical recipe aggregate size.

metadata.recommendedNext: After the trusted-history/integration gate permits new ObjectGenome source work, decompose one bounded source-only leaf (suggested identity: HG-OBJECTGENOME-RECIPE-BUDGET) that gives canonical ObjectGenome v1 an explicit project-owned total recipe envelope. Prefer a small set of construction-relevant count ceilings plus an aggregate text/recipe byte or node budget rather than arbitrary tiny per-field limits. Regress exact maximum/max+1 provenance/collection cases and a worst-case support-chain adversary. Preserve StableId/schema/fingerprint bytes for already-valid ordinary fixtures; do not widen retained PR #395 while it is blocked only on trust.
